title: Introduce semantic token ramps and compact radii for data-dense surfaces
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a cohesive set of semantic design tokens for color, typography, spacing, radius, and elevation focused on data-dense surfaces (chart palettes, compact controls and tables). This work defines new token ramps to meet AA/AAA contrast targets for critical text and chart elements, introduces a compact radius scale for dense UIs, and provides migration guidance for engineers and product teams. Scope covers Figma token library updates, CSS/SCSS variables, token mapping in the component library, and a docs migration guide.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined in Figma and exported to token JSON with unique names (semantic.* + scale.*) and example usage for charts, tables, and small controls
Color ramps for primary/neutral/semantic and a dedicated 12-step chart series pass WCAG AA for key contrasts (labels on series, hover states) based on test report
Compact radius and spacing scales implemented in component CSS with a single flag (data-compact=true) to toggle dense mode
Typography scale updated for compact mode (xs, sm adjusted) with line-height rules to avoid clipping on buttons and table cells
Migration guide published with mapped equivalences from old tokens to new tokens and a rollout plan including canary components
Unit visual regression snapshots updated and new storybook examples for 'compact' and 'data-dense' variants
Design and engineering approval comments resolved and at least one cross-team review completed (PM + Accessibility)
Performance evaluation notes added: verify no runtime token expansion causing layout jank in main dashboards
updates: 2026-02-28: Ticket created with initial research summary and proposal to standardize on semantic tokens (surface, emphasis, neutral, info, success, warn, danger) and add a 12-step chart palette.
2026-03-03: Ran contrast audits against current palette; neutral-700 fails AA for small text in dark modes. Proposed swap to neutral-750 and adjust emphasis-600. Added test matrix to Confluence.

2026-03-05: Design spike: explored compact radius options (2px, 4px, 6px) and compact spacing (4/8 grid). Preferred 4px corner for buttons and 2px for icon-only controls. Captured interaction trade-offs: tighter radii increase perceived density but improve alignment in tables.

2026-03-07: Engineering sync — ENG-3421 to add token feature flag and runtime mapping; ENG-3499 to update storybook themes. Decision: use CSS custom properties with fallback tokens to preserve backwards compatibility.

2026-03-10: Accessibility review with Leah Morris — recommended increasing chart label contrast and adding focused-visible outlines for compact controls. Marked two follow-ups: update hover color and confirm keyboard hit targets.

2026-03-12: Created Figma components for compact variants and exported token JSON. Initial PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-components/pull/784. Requesting engineering review for CSS integration tests.

2026-03-14: Resolved naming conflicts for semantic token names (renamed 'surface-alt' -> 'surface-subtle' to avoid ambiguity). Preparing migration guide and rollout checklist. Next: schedule cross-team demo and prepare canary release with telemetry events to measure click targets and layout regressions.
